prompt: Who is the most recent female middle school student to represent China in the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) contest?
answer: The most recent female student to represent China at the IMO was **Yan Binwei (严彬玮)**. She competed in the **2020 IMO**, winning a **silver medal** as the only girl on China’s six-member team. She was a student at **Nanjing Normal University Affiliated High School**.
